definition: Of the mind or heart: gathered together and unified, the state that samādhi names.
notes: The participle follows the samādhi headword, now governed as unification of mind: a samāhita heart is a unified heart, gathered together rather than narrowed onto one point. Composed is kept as a continuity alternate for material written before the 2026-11-08 revision. Its negation asamāhita is ununified.
version_notes: Added 2026-11-08 to govern wording the samādhi ruling introduced into the translations.
